summary: A man in a dark jacket aims a futuristic rifle with a scope and bipod against a green screen background.

visuals.description: A man, seen from the side, is aiming a large, futuristic rifle with a scope and bipod. He is wearing a dark, padded jacket. Concrete balusters are in the foreground and background, with a bright green screen behind them.
notable_elements: futuristic rifle with scope and bipod
